title: Confusion: delirium and cognitive testing
stem: Cubicle 14. Madam Ho, 82, was brought in by her daughter: over two days she has become muddled, seeing cats that are not there, awake at night. Assess her cognition and decide what is going on.

phases.title: Collateral history
phases.goal: His baseline, the timeline, and the causes.

phases.title: 4AT and examination
phases.goal: Test attention and look for the cause.

phases.title: Plan
phases.goal: Treat the causes; manage the delirium.

notes:
Checked against NICE CG103 (Delirium, updated 2023), the 4AT (www.the4AT.com), the MMSE (copyright PAR; use a licensed form) and the Abbreviated Mental Test.

Delirium: acute onset, fluctuating course, inattention, and altered awareness or disorganised thinking (CAM). The 4AT (Alertness, AMT4, Attention — months backwards, Acute change or fluctuating course) is quick and needs no training; 4 or more suggests delirium. Hypoactive delirium is common and missed. Look for causes (PINCHME: Pain, Infection, Nutrition, Constipation, Hydration, Medication, Environment; plus retention, hypoxia, electrolytes, alcohol withdrawal, stroke). Treat the cause; reorientation, glasses and hearing aids, family presence, sleep; avoid restraint; antipsychotics (low-dose haloperidol) only for severe distress or danger, and not in Parkinson's or Lewy body dementia.

Dementia: insidious, progressive, attention preserved early; MMSE/MoCA help but are not diagnostic in acute illness. Your notes on delirium versus dementia, CAM and the MMSE match; the MMSE normal cut-off depends on education (your notes: 25 or more with over 7 years of schooling). Visual hallucinations suggest delirium, drugs or Lewy body disease.

steps.label: Collateral history
steps.hint: Baseline, onset, fluctuation, new medicines, infection symptoms, falls, alcohol.

Baseline.rz: 好精㗎！同我住，自己去買餸，仲會打麻雀。
Baseline.r: Sharp! Lives with me, does the shopping, plays mahjong.

Baseline.t: When did this start? Is it the same all day?
Baseline.tz: 幾時開始變成咁？成日都一樣嘅？
Baseline.rz: 兩日前突然間變嘅。夜晚差啲；有啲時候又差唔多正常。
Baseline.r: Two days ago, suddenly. Worse at night; some hours she's almost normal.

Causes.t: Any fever, cough, passing urine more, pain, constipation?
Causes.tz: 佢有冇發燒、咳、多咗去廁所、邊度痛，或者便秘？
Causes.rz: 成日去廁所，小便好臭。四日冇大過便。
Causes.r: Going to the toilet a lot, smells strong. Hasn't opened her bowels for 4 days.

Causes.rz: 家庭醫生上個禮拜開咗隻膀胱藥（oxybutynin）俾佢。
Causes.r: The GP started a bladder tablet (oxybutynin) last week.

Causes.tz: 有冇跌親或者撞到頭？有冇飲酒？

steps.label: 4AT and examination
steps.hint: Alertness, AMT4, months backwards, acute change; then examine for causes.

4AT.r: Drowsy but rousable to voice — abnormal (4 points).

4AT.t: AMT4: age, date of birth, place, year
4AT.r: Knows her birth date only — 2 or more errors (2 points).

4AT.t: Attention: months of the year backwards

4AT.r: Yes, from the daughter (4 points). Total 11: likely delirium.
4AT.mark: Scores acute change; 4AT total suggests delirium

Examination.r: Temp 38.1, HR 104. Suprapubic tenderness, palpable bladder. Chest clear. No focal neurology.
Examination.mark: Examines for causes (retention, infection, focal signs)

steps.ask: Thank you. What is your plan?
steps.label: Plan
steps.hint: Treat causes, stop the culprit drug, non-drug measures, avoid sedation.

opts.t: Catheterise for retention; urine culture; blood cultures and bloods
Reorientation, glasses and hearing aids, daughter present, sleep, avoid moving beds
Haloperidol 5 mg IM to stop the hallucinations
opts.r: Antipsychotics only for severe distress or danger, at low dose, after non-drug measures.

qs.q: Key feature separating delirium from dementia?
wrong: Memory loss for recent events, but not remote ones

qs.q: Which delirium subtype is most often missed?
Drug class that commonly causes delirium in the elderly?

badge.flavor: Acute, fluctuating, inattentive: find the cause, not the sedative.

options: Delirium, drugs or Lewy body dementia
